newsitem.title: CHINA: China air conditioner demand to hit 6 mln in '96.
newsitem.headline: China air conditioner demand to hit 6 mln in '96.

text.p: Demand for air conditioners in China this year is expected to be six million, almost half of nationwide production capacity of 10.2 million units, the China Securities said on Thursday.
By the year 2000, China will become the world's largest air conditioner market with annual demand reaching 10 million units and growing at an annual rate of 13 percent, it said.
Some 25 percent of China's 80 million urban households would have an air conditioner by 2000, it said.
However, recent oversupply and weak demand in the domestic market has been pushing down prices and forced some manufacturers to shut down, said reports earlier this year.
